$comment: Generated by scripts/GenerateParts.mjs from packages/ui/src and the descriptions in packages/ui/src/parts.json; do not edit. Part classes and state attributes are public and versioned. In a state, values lists what the attribute takes; "" is an attribute set without a value, and an empty list one that takes any value or is selected by its presence alone.
